claim.architecture_y: deterministic ordered comparison decision tree over n stored keys
assumptions: The universe is {0,...,U-1}, the set contains n distinct keys with U>n, and X uses a U-bit vector.
A word-RAM computes the query address and reads one indexed bit in constant time.
Y is a deterministic ordered comparison decision tree over n distinct stored keys.
The measured resource is worst-case sequential key comparisons or indexed bit reads per query.

x_bound.resource: worst-case sequential memory probes/comparisons per membership query

y_bound.resource: worst-case sequential memory probes/comparisons per membership query

obligations.statement: Reading bit q returns membership of q by representation definition.
X performs exactly one indexed bit read per query.
A height-h comparison tree stores at most 2^h-1 equality keys.
